    suffixes = set()
    
    # Iterate over all possible roots
    for i in range(1, n - 4):
        root = s[:i]
        suffix = ""
        
        # Iterate over the remaining part of the string

            if len(suffix) == 2 or len(suffix) == 3:

    suffixes = sorted(suffixes)
